nodes.title: Calling the studio-router chatStream failure a load flake was wrong. npm test runs every file in one process, so classify.test.mjs's top-level beforeEach (a canned-reply globalThis.fetch stub) also wrapped this test, which then got that stub's 200 text/plain reply and no SSE events. Proven by logging globalThis.fetch at failure (2026-10-05, full npm test, n=1; same failure on GitHub gates runs 121-131). Fix: the test uses the fetch captured at module load and restores the stub after. Reverse if: tests move to process isolation and the file-level capture becomes unnecessary.
